takeaways: The strongest unused X Shadyside material is the Dec 2022 influencer-team neon group shot (Edited Photos/Group cell 2, also in Jason/Jared sets), which should be the X Shadyside cover and lead image on work/x-shadyside and service:influencer-marketing. The Aug 2023 pro Photos folder (group class lunge DSC04256, moody back-squat DSC04200/04205, trainer bench spot) is polished and completely unused, ideal for the case-study gallery and service:content-development. The color-graded 'Moody Grade' vertical clips (team in red/teal neon, group barbell set) are real hero-loop candidates for the vertical stacks, a moodier contrast to the existing Lucid Juice reel. The 'Don't Do 2023 Alone' square ad and 'Fall Into Fitness' story graphics can show service:digital-advertising creative, though the 2023 copy and the '12 month' typo limit them. Analytics screenshots are not display-worthy, but Ashley's reel (~28K reached, ~34K plays) is a quotable proof stat for the case study and blog:influencer-marketing-roi-guide.
